quests.instruction: Where is the teddy bear if he is hidden safely beneath a wooden table out of sight?
quests.question: Under
quests.hint: Choose under as the positional place.
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: When it rains, standing under a big umbrella keeps you nice and dry!

quests.instruction: Where is the teddy bear if he is nestled cozy inside a colorful toy chest basket?
quests.question: In
quests.hint: Choose in as the positional place.
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: You put all your colorful toys in the toy box to keep your room clean!

quests.instruction: Where is the teddy bear if he is hidden directly back of a flowery window curtain?
quests.question: Behind
quests.hint: Choose behind as the positional place.
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: When you stand behind something, it can completely hide you from the front!

quests.funFact: If you put your favorite toy on the table, it rests right on top!
